mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_password, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, memberweight, member_phone, card_time, card_class, card_next_class) VALUES (#{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberGender}, #{memberAge}, #{memberHeight}, #{memberweight}, #{memberPhone}, #{cardTime}, #{cardClass}, #{cardNextClass})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_password = #{memberPassword}, member_name = #{memberName}, member_gender = #{memberGender}, member_age = #{memberAge}, member_height = #{memberHeight}, memberweight = #{memberweight}, member_phone = #{memberPhone}, card_time = #{cardTime}, card_class = #{cardClass}, card_next_class = #{cardNextClass} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
